name: hyphae-workspace-tools
description: Dev-only JS/TS lint and test entry points for Hyphae (core hyp binary remains pure static Rust with zero runtime Node.js dependency).

scripts.lint:js: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings plugins site workers scripts itest
scripts.test:js: node --test plugins/test/jsonrpc_v2.test.mjs plugins/test/sdk_and_prometheus.test.mjs plugins/test/sources.test.mjs plugins/herdr-mod/test/mod.test.mjs plugins/openclaw/test/openclaw.test.mjs plugins/openclaw/test/openclaw_shim_e2e.test.mjs plugins/opencode/test/opencode.test.mjs site/join/join.test.mjs workers/drop-relay/test/worker.test.mjs scripts/test-drop-crypto.mjs itest/suites/llm-shim.test.ts
